# ADR 0005: Streaming, idempotent bulk import

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Consumer complaints triage and SLA service

## Context

The source file is several GB with quoted multi-line fields.

## Decision

Stream with a real CSV parser, filter while reading, load in batches/COPY, upsert on complaint ID.

## Consequences

Constant memory, repeatable imports.

## Alternatives considered

Loading the whole file into memory; split(',') parsing.
